title: Gold does not fall from 09:30 Taipei: the 2-hour return is +0.08 points on 675 weekdays, and Asian-morning S1 longs won more often than other S1, not less
question: Does gold tend to fall after 09:30 Taipei, and especially after an Asian-morning S1 signal, so that reversing it pays?
hypothesis: An Asian-session S1: the market opens at nine and starts falling by half past nine (a trader's stated reason for reversing a signal, 2026-10-20).

findings.title: 09:30 is an ordinary half-hour
findings.detail: On 675 weekdays (2024-01 to 2026-08) the 2-hour return from the 09:30 open averaged +0.08 points (+0.005%, bound ±0.039%) and was negative on 46.7% of days — fewer than half. 09:30 ranks 20th of 48 half-hour starts. The 1-hour and 4-hour windows are also slightly positive; 09:00–09:30 is flat.

findings.title: Asian-morning S1 longs did better, not worse
findings.detail: 51 S1 trades entered 07:00–09:29 Taipei won 64.7% (mean +32 USD) against 54.9% (+17 USD) for the other 421 — the opposite of the claim, and inside noise (9.8 points against a 20.6 bound).
findings.title_zh: 亞盤早上的 S1 多單反而贏得比較多

findings.title: After a morning S1 the next 2 hours are a coin toss
findings.detail: On the 51 days with a morning S1, the 09:30-to-11:30 return averaged −3.7 points but the median was +0.5 and 49% of days fell; one or two large drops make the mean. A short from 09:30 would have profited on 49% of those days before costs.
findings.title_zh: 早上有 S1 的日子，接下來 2 小時是擲銅板
findings.detail_zh: 51 個早上有 S1 的日子，09:30 到 11:30 平均 −3.7 點，但中位數 +0.5 點，下跌的日子 49%；平均值是少數幾天大跌拉出來的。09:30 放空，未計成本只有 49% 的日子賺錢。

findings.title: Live: 3 morning S1, all stopped
findings.detail: Since 2026-08-17 the ledger has three S1 signals between 07:00 and 09:29 (08-25, 09-22, 10-19, all 07:00); the strategy stopped out on all three. That is probably what the saying remembers; three is not a sample.
findings.title_zh: 實盤：早上 3 筆 S1，全部停損
findings.detail_zh: 8/17 以來，帳本裡 07:00–09:29 的 S1 有 3 筆（8/25、9/22、10/19，都是 07:00），策略都打到停損。這可能就是「亞盤 S1 會跌」印象的來源，但 3 筆不是樣本。

card_summary: On 675 weekdays gold's 2-hour return from 09:30 Taipei averaged +0.08 points and fell on 47% of days; 09:30 is an ordinary half-hour. S1 longs entered 07:00–09:29 won 65% against 55% for other S1 — the opposite of the claim, inside noise. Reversing an Asian-morning S1 has no support.
title_zh: 黃金不會在台北 09:30 之後開始跌：675 個交易日 2 小時平均 +0.08 點；亞盤早上的 S1 多單反而贏得比較多
question_zh: 黃金在台北時間 09:30 之後是否傾向下跌？亞盤早上出現 S1 之後是否更明顯，反手做空是否有利？
hypothesis_zh: 亞盤 S1：通常九點開盤，九點半就開始跌（一筆實際反手的理由，2026-10-20）。
card_summary_zh: 675 個交易日，台北 09:30 起算 2 小時平均 +0.08 點，下跌的日子 47%，09:30 是很普通的時段。07:00–09:29 進場的 S1 勝率 65%，其他 S1 55%——和說法相反，且在雜訊內。反手做空亞盤早上的 S1 沒有證據支持。
limitations_zh: 回測資料到 2026-08-15；之後 3 筆早上的實盤訊號只列出，不檢定。
報酬用 30 分 K 開盤到開盤，未計點差與成本。
時段用台北時間，沒有分開美國夏令時間的影響。
interpretation_zh: 「九點半開始跌」在 675 天的資料裡看不到；早上的 S1 多單在回測裡反而比較好。實盤 3 筆都停損，很可能是這個印象的來源，但 3 筆不夠。不要用這個理由反手做空；亞盤早上的 S1 照一般 S1 判斷。
